title: Voice Order Support Agent — Tool Contracts
notes: Every tool sets strict:true at the provider boundary, which requires additionalProperties:false and an explicit required list on every input_schema.

customer_id is DELIBERATELY absent from every schema. Customer scoping is applied server-side from the authenticated session (FR-003, TC-003). If the model proposes a customer identifier it is ignored, not honoured.
latency_class is a required registry attribute, not a model-visible field. An unclassified tool MUST NOT be registered (TC-001).
state_changing tools require a confirmed PendingAction before dispatch (FR-023) and derive an idempotency key from turn_id (TC-004).
speculative_safe:false means the tool may never run during a speculative dispatch, enforced by the ToolRegistry call context rather than by prompting.

tools.name: list_recent_orders
tools.description: List the shopper's recent orders so the agent can identify which order they mean. Returns the most distinguishing attributes for disambiguation.

lookback_days.description: How far back to search. Default 90.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Full detail of one order including line items and per-item return eligibility.

order_ref.description: Full order id, or the final 4 characters for a partial match (FR-021).

tools.name: get_shipment_tracking
tools.description: Delivery progress for an order. Returns one entry per shipment; an order may have several (split shipments).
tools.contract_note: not_yet_shipped is a first-class result, not a failure. The agent MUST NOT state a carrier or tracking number when it is returned (FR-019).

tools.name: get_product_info
tools.description: Attributes and care information for a product the shopper purchased.
tools.contract_note: Merchant-supplied free text. Rendered into the prompt inside a delimited block declared non-authoritative; treated as data, never instructions (FR-049, TC-006).

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Store policy on a topic, plus the parameters needed to apply it to a specific order.

tools.name: create_return
tools.description: Create a return for specific line items. Requires an explicit confirmed read-back first.
tools.contract_note: Idempotency key derived from turn_id and enforced by a UNIQUE database constraint. A repeat returns the existing row with deduplicated:true — it never creates a second return and never errors (FR-029).

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order that has not yet shipped.
tools.contract_note: already_shipped MUST lead the agent to offer a return instead of refusing flatly (FR-027, VID-015).

tools.name: update_shipping_address
tools.description: Change the delivery address of an order that has not yet shipped.
tools.contract_note: The full address is read back aloud before applying (FR-028).

tools.name: request_policy_exception
tools.description: Ask a human to consider an out-of-policy request. The agent has no authority to grant exceptions itself.
tools.contract_note: Slow class — a holding phrase fires if it has not returned within 400 ms (FR-050).

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Hand off to a human with full context. Called immediately on explicit request, with no reason required and no argument.
tools.contract_note: Never gated behind a reason, a retry, or an argument from the agent (FR-032). The transcript pointer is attached server-side, not passed by the model.
